name: Native original work direct cross-owner UI MOVE into Free Cities exact Temple

condition.code:
local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')
if not plan or not plan.WorkIndex then return false end
local donor=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y)
local free=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y)
return donor and donor:GetOwner()==plan.Work.Owner and donor:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)==plan.WorkIndex
 and free and free:GetOwner()==plan.Free and free:GetID()==plan.ID and free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1

steps.code:
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local donor=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y))
local free=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y))
assert(donor:GetOwner()==plan.Work.Owner and donor:GetID()==plan.Work.CityID and free:GetOwner()==plan.Free and free:GetID()==plan.ID,'cross-owner city identity changed')
assert(donor:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)==plan.WorkIndex and free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1,'cross-owner source or recipient slot changed')
local params={}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=plan.Work.Owner
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=donor:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=free:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=plan.Work.Building
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=plan.Building
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=plan.WorkIndex
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=plan.Slot
Events.GreatWorkMoved.Add(function(...) local args={...};for i=1,#args do args[i]=tostring(args[i]) end;print('[JAC_NATIVE_CROSS_FREE_EVENT] '..table.concat(args,',')) end)
local returned=UI.RequestPlayerOperation(Game.GetLocalPlayer(),PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_CROSS_FREE_REQUEST] actor='..Game.GetLocalPlayer()..' owner='..plan.Work.Owner..' free='..plan.Free..' result='..tostring(returned)..' srcCity='..donor:GetID()..' dstCity='..free:GetID())
return 'cross-owner official MOVE requested; physical result unproven'

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local donor=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y))
local free=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y))
local src=donor:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)
local dst=free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)
local count=0;local found
local owners,seen={},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[plan.Free] then owners[#owners+1]=plan.Free end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
 local p=Players[owner]
 if p then for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do
  local b=city:GetBuildings()
  for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
   for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==plan.WorkIndex then count=count+1;found={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=def.Index,Slot=slot} end end
  end end
 end end
end
ExposedMembers.JAC_CrossFreePhysical={Count=count,Found=found,Source=src,Dest=dst}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_CROSS_FREE_PHYSICAL] count='..count..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dst)..' owner='..tostring(found and found.Owner))
return 'cross-owner work physical scan count='..count..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dst)

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local result=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_CrossFreePhysical)
assert(result.Count==1 and result.Source==-1 and result.Dest==plan.WorkIndex,'cross-owner MOVE did not physically put original work in Free Cities Temple')
local found=assert(result.Found)
assert(found.Owner==plan.Free and found.City==plan.ID and found.X==plan.X and found.Y==plan.Y and found.Building==plan.Building and found.Slot==plan.Slot,'cross-owner MOVE reached a different slot')
return 'same original index moved directly to the exact Free Cities Temple'
